page.layout: One page of text, single column; marginal notes in the right margin (small marks, several faint ones, not legible as notes); catchword-like fragment "Infe-" at lower right inside the text block.

main_text.p:
Speratósque leges sine sollicitudine fructus,
Nullàque fallacis delufus imagine somni
Irrita mendaci facies conuicia noctis.

Expectatus Hymen iam iunget fœdere dextras,
Mox etiam amplecti, mox & geminare licebit
Basia, mox etiam non tantùm basia, sed tu
Quamlibet approperes, animo moderare, beatum
Nobiscum partire diem, tu gaudia noctis
Solus tota feres: quanquam neque gaudia noctis
Solus tota feres: & nos communiter æquum est
Laticiam gaudere tuam, communia vota
Fecimus, & sacras pariter placauimus aras,
Miscuimusque preces, & spesque metusque tuosq;
Sensimus affectus, agrè tecum haufimus una
Tedia longa mora. Superi nunc plena secundi
Gaudia cum referant. sensus peruenit ad omnes
Laticiæ, mentemque cieus renouata voluptas
Crescit, & exultant trepidis pracordia fibris,
Qualis vbi Eois Phœbus caput extulit vrbis
Purus, & auratum non turbidus extulit axem,
Cuspide iucunda lucis percussa renident
Arua, micat tremulo crispatus lumine pontus,
Lenibus aspirat flabris innubilus aër,
Blanda serenati ridet clementia cœli.
At si nubiferòs effuderis Aeolus Austros,
Et pluuijs grauidam cœlo subtexuit umbram,
Mœsta horret rerum facies, deformia lugent
Arua, tumentque fluctus, campiq; grauis incubat aër,
Torpet & obduetum picea caligine cœlum.
Sic ex te populus suspenso gaudia, curas,
Mœrorèsque trahit, rosea nec sola iuuenta
Florida, nec spatijs quæ te propioribus atras

page.notes: Marginal notes at the right margin are faint and illegible and are not transcribed. Some words in the lower lines are uncertain; the page is a scan with damaged edges. Catchword "Infe-" is set at the lower right.
